snippet.title: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 - Momiji Debut and Morphing Ninja Costumes Trailer
snippet.description:
Fan favorite Momiji joins the DEAD OR ALIVE 6 roster as part of Season Pass 2. Additionally Team Ninja bring you brand-new Morphing Ninja Costumes that change colour when you taunt or use a break blow! 

Check out all the latest info here: bit.ly/DOA6EU
